title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Specimen Bio collects, uses, and protects personal information when you use our website and services.

seo.metaDescription: How Specimen Bio collects, uses, and protects personal information.

children.text: Specimen Bio provides professional biospecimen procurement services. If you have questions about this policy, contact us at info@specimenbio.com.

We may collect information you submit through our contact forms, including your name, email address, organization, and message details. We may also collect basic technical data such as browser type and pages visited.
We use the information you provide to respond to inquiries, evaluate provider or biospecimen requests, improve our website, and meet legal or contractual obligations.

We do not sell personal information. We may share information with trusted service providers who help us operate our site and communications, or when required by law. We retain information only as long as needed for those purposes.
You may contact us to request access, correction, or deletion of personal information we hold about you, subject to applicable law.

title: Privacy Officer
intro: Contact our Privacy Officer for questions, access requests, or concerns about how Specimen Bio handles personal information.

seo.metaDescription: Contact Specimen Bio’s Privacy Officer for privacy questions and requests.

children.text: The Privacy Officer oversees Specimen Bio’s approach to personal information, including responses to privacy inquiries and coordination of privacy-related practices across our services.
Please include enough detail for us to understand and respond to your request. We will acknowledge inquiries and follow up within a reasonable timeframe.
When contacting the Privacy Officer, it helps to include your name, preferred contact email, the nature of your request, and any relevant dates or references.

title: Cookie Settings
intro: This page explains how Specimen Bio uses cookies and similar technologies on our website, and the choices available to you.

seo.metaDescription: Learn how Specimen Bio uses cookies and manage your preferences.

children.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help sites remember preferences, understand how pages are used, and keep basic functionality working.

We may use essential cookies required for the site to function, as well as limited analytics cookies that help us understand traffic and improve the experience. We do not use cookies to sell your personal information.
You can control cookies through your browser settings, including blocking or deleting cookies. Disabling certain cookies may affect how some parts of the site work.
